name: SendUp - Send Files Anywhere
summary:
Share files to nearby devices like phones, PCs, browsers & VR. Fast P2P sharing.

Looking for an easy way to share files between different devices? 
Meet SendUP - your cross-platform file transfer and file sharing solution. Send files between Android phones, iPhones, Android TVs, Windows PCs, Linux, macOS, web browsers and VR headsets like Android XR and Meta Quest.
